column1: # Sprite-sheet labels. Columns: sheet leaf, x, y, w, h, text ("|" = next line, empty = clear), style, records.
# Style (comma-separated): cN fixed colour index, oN outline index, fNAME font from fonts/, from=x+y+w+h take colours from another rect,
#   pack = find a new rect wide enough (x y w h are the old one, records must re-point), strip=x+y;x+y.. text across 16-px cells drawn on a 14-px pitch.
# Records: TABLE:INDEX or TABLE:x,y (the record now at that rect), comma-free list by ";"-less single entries: point them at this row's rect.
# SYSTEM/5.5 equipment and camp labels: re-packed, the table in its tail re-pointed, so no label has to fit its kanji's width.
# SYSTEM/3.1 save screen (rects from SYSTEM/3.0.1). The game shows `Data` or `Room` + `missing` from two sprites, so the second half is empty.
# SYSTEM/0.2 weapon type cells: one letter-cell each, so three-letter flags (flagged in docs/decisions.md D15)
